initHint:
🐈‍⬛ FCM v{0} initialized. Click the "SVG" icon to manage friends and rooms; first-time users may want a quick setup on the Settings page.
⚠ Note: newly added friends may show as "one-way" — try removing and re-adding them. This issue has been reported to the community.
noAdminWarn: ⚠ No admin rights — Room Admin column is view-only
setAvatarsNote: Show portraits (saved on encounter, stored in FCM-Snapshot DB)
whisperIndicatorNote: Shows a purple glow on the chat input when /w /whisper /beep is typed or whisper mode is active
ghostHideNote: Characters on your ghost list are hidden in chatroom (only affects your view)
reloadAvatarsNote: Clear cache or load friend avatars
loadFriendAvatarsNote: Scan all friends, wait for BC to cache appearances, then snapshot (may take tens of seconds)
clearAvatarCacheNote: Delete all saved avatar snapshots — new ones will be captured on next encounter
noProfile:
No profile data
(Must have been in same room)
confirmAddBan:
Blacklist "{0}"?
They will no longer be able to interact with you.
confirmAddGhost:
Add "{0}" to ghost list?
You will no longer receive any messages from that person.
beepPlaceholder:
Type message (can be empty)
Ctrl+Enter to send
beepSummonTitle:
You must have the authority to summon the other player.
Otherwise, they will only receive "summon".
beepSummonNoRoom: Must be in a room to summon
saveModeDesc_off: Don't save any data. If you have WCE with Profiles enabled, choose this to avoid duplicates (WCE already saves for you).
saveModeDesc_name: Save member number, BC name, and nickname only. Minimal space, used for displaying offline friend names.
saveModeDesc_avatar: Also save avatar snapshot (auto-captured when encountered, stored in separate FCM-Snapshot DB).
saveModeDesc_full: Full save: name, nickname, appearance/BIO/title etc. Fully compatible with WCE bce-past-profiles DB. Avatars stored separately in FCM-Snapshot.
wceDetected: ✅ WCE Profiles detected — auto-set to Full mode (shared DB, no conflicts)
wceNotDetected: WCE not detected. Use Name-only for minimal storage, or Name+Avatar if you want portraits.
importNote: Import from JSON (newer seen timestamp wins on conflict)
peopleSearchPlaceholder: Name or ID — press Enter to search...
peopleSearchHint: Showing last 100 encountered · type then press Enter or click Search
peopleUnknownId: Did you mean #{0}? No record found for this ID.
peopleOneSidedWarn: ⚠ Note: This action is a one-way addition. If necessary, please notify the other party yourself.
whisperAvatarNote: Displays the target's avatar near the chat input when in whisper/BEEP mode
oocProtectNote: In whisper/BEEP mode, blocks Ctrl+Enter to prevent OOC content from being sent as normal chat
btnVisibilityNote: Control which screens show the FCM button (at least one must remain enabled)
profileRelNote: On a character profile page, turn related people (owner/lovers) IDs into buttons — click to open FCM People search prefilled with that ID (requires the Profile save feature)
friendReqNeedRoom: Must be in the same room to notify
friendReqIncoming: {0} sent you a friend request. Do you accept?
roomReenterConfirm:
You are already in "{0}".
Re-enter the room?
beepSummonConfirm:
Make sure you have permission to summon them, otherwise they will only receive the text "summon".

Summon "{0}"?
peopleDbNotConnected: DB not connected — set a save mode in Settings
shareNeedRoom: Must be in a chat room to share
cmdProfilesDesc: <filter> - Open People search (filter by name or ID)
roomShareNeedRoom: Must be in a chat room to share
themeColorNote: Customize panel background, text and accent (borders / tabs / glow) colors
chatAvatarShapeNote: Avatar appearance in chat list and balloons
chatAvatarSourceNote: Set separately from FCM avatar source
chatAvatarUrlNote: Only used when CHAT avatar source is set to URL
chatConfirmDeleteConv: Delete all local chat history with "{0}"?
chatEmptyCategory: No players in this category yet
chatIndividualBalloonsNote: Each messaging player uses a separate balloon
chatNotifyAnimNote: Play an alert animation when new messages arrive
chatNotifyAudioNote: Play a sound on new messages
chatPersistentBalloonNote: Keep the main balloon always visible
chatSendFailed: Send failed. Your text was kept. Profiles cannot be shared offline; check profile availability, message length and send permissions.
chatSelectPlayer: Select a player to start chatting
chatSoundCustomNote: Upload audio, saved in a separate FCM Chat Audio DB
chatSoundNote: Select a built-in game alert sound
chatTakeoverNote: Opens that player's chat when pressed
chatThemeNote: Follow FCM or use an independent preset theme
chatThemePresetNote: Choose the theme used by CHAT
chatTranslateAutoNote: Automatically translate new messages on arrival
chatTranslateEnableNote: Translate incoming messages into the target language
chatTranslateKeyNote: Some services require a key (leave blank for free endpoint)
balloonSnapNote: Automatically snaps a dragged balloon to the nearest screen edge
chatRoomInviteIncoming: {0} invited you to join a room
chatProfileNotFound: No saved profile found; this will be sent as a plain @ID
bypassBcxCommunicationNote: Off by default. When enabled, FCM bypasses BCX restrictions on sending and receiving BEEPs and whispers.
bcxWhisperBlocked: BCX prevents you from sending whispers
bcxBeepBlocked: BCX prevents you from sending private messages
